company.description:
VaycayHero is a safest and easiest way to rent vacation homes. 

VaycayHero, previously known as Zaranga, was launched in order to take the hassle out of booking vacations rentals without having to worry about the kinds of things Amitav and Anirban experienced while trying to simply go on a great vacation. Their rentals are 100% accurate and verified by professionals with automatically updated calendars and pricing. You will only find top-notch professionally managed vacation rentals on VaycayHero. Search and book online hassle-free, or chat with our booking concierge if you need some help.
